Let $X_1$, $X_2$, ..., $X_n$ be iid from some member of the parametric family that you met on [Problem Set 6](https://anyakatsevich.github.io/sta240-s26.github.io/problems/pset-6.html#problem-1):

$$
f(x\,|\,\theta)=\theta(x+1)^{-(\theta+1)},\quad x>0.
$$

a.  What is the maximum likelihood estimator of $\theta>0$?
a.  What is the sampling distribution of the estimator?
a.  What is the MSE of the estimator?
